name: Albons (Spain)
description: Green field with a white central pale, each green part charged with a white eight-pointed star.
history: The flag was approved by the municipal council on 28 November 1994 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya on 25 January 1995; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, green, with a central white pale 2/9 of the length and a white eight-pointed star of diameter 1/3 of the height at the centre of each green part.

features.role: one star at the centre of each green part
